notes: Woori Bank India. Interactive JSP page, Korean by default (must switch to English). Term deposit page only shows a single range (3.75%-6.75% for 7d-10yr) — no granular slab-wise rates published.

gap_classification.notes: Woori Bank operates as a foreign-bank branch in India (Chennai/Gurgaon) and reports to RBI; per third-party listings it offers NRE/NRO/FCNR deposits. Its only web presence is the Korean parent global portal (go.wooribank.com, HTTP 200) and the netbanking login (spib.wooribank.com) — neither publishes a public India FD interest-rate page. in.wooribank.com does not resolve (HTTP 000). The only rate listings found are aggregators (codeforbanks), which are banned as a source.
